title: Why a modern approach to healthcare must consider more than illness | New Scientist
description: Pills and other medications may seem like the most rigorous way to treat illness, but we increasingly know that our health must revolve around the whole mind and body
author: New Scientist

title: Slashing sugar intake before antibiotics may save your microbiome | New Scientist
description: Antibiotics can reduce the diversity of microbes in your gut and lead to health problems, but a study in people with cancer has identified a potential solution
author: Chris Simms

title: 'Astonishing' weight loss when GLP-1 drug used with second medication | New Scientist
description: Tirzepatide, sold as Mounjaro and Zepbound, is our most potent weight-loss drug, but it can have an even greater effect when combined with a complementary medicine
author: Carissa Wong

title: Explainer: What is El Niño? | New Scientist
description: Every few years, a disturbance in the Pacific Ocean is amplified by feedback mechanisms in the atmosphere, unleashing heat and extreme weather around the globe
author: Alec Luhn

title: Urban trees in south-east England can't cope with the changing climate | New Scientist
description: In cities such as London, trees are already struggling with hot and dry summers. Botanists warn that we need to start replacing them with drought-adapted species
author: Madeleine Cuff

title: Spectacular feathered dinosaur fossil shows bird-like adaptations | New Scientist
description: An exquisitely preserved fossil found in China shows that many anatomical features seen in birds also evolved independently in another group of dinosaurs
author: James Woodford
